ABSTRACT

摘要

Generative models have demonstrated significant results in ultra-low bitrate image compression, owing to their powerful capabilities for content generation and texture completion.

生成模型具备强大的内容生成与纹理补全能力，已在超低码率图像压缩中取得显著成效。

Existing works primarily based on diffusion models still face challenges such as limited bitrate adaptability and high computational complexity for encoding and decoding.

现有工作主要基于扩散模型，仍面临码率适应能力有限、编解码计算复杂度高等挑战。

Inspired by the success of Visual AutoRegressive model (VAR), we introduce AutoRegressive-based Progressive Coding (ARPC) for ultra-low bitrate image compression, a progressive image compression framework based on next-scale prediction visual autoregressive model.

受视觉自回归模型（VAR）成功的启发，我们提出面向超低码率图像压缩的自回归渐进编码（ARPC），这是一个基于下一尺度预测式视觉自回归模型的渐进图像压缩框架。

Based on multi-scale residual vector quantizer, ARPC efficiently encodes the image into multi-scale discrete token maps and controls the bitrates by selecting different scales for transmission.

ARPC 通过多尺度残差向量量化器高效地将图像编码为多尺度离散词元图，并通过选择传输尺度来控制码率。

For decompression, ARPC leverages the prior knowledge inherent in the visual autoregressive model to predict the unreceived scales, which is naturally the autoregressive generation process.

解压时，ARPC 利用视觉自回归模型自身的先验预测未接收的尺度，这本身就是自回归生成过程。

To further increase the compression ratio, we target the VAR as a probability estimator for lossless entropy coding and propose group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer to adaptively allocate bits for different scales.

为进一步提高压缩比，我们将 VAR 用作无损熵编码的概率估计器，并提出分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器，为不同尺度自适应分配比特。

Extensive experiments show that ARPC achieves state-of-the-art perceptual fidelity at ultra-low bitrates and high decompression efficiency compared with existing diffusion-based methods.

大量实验表明，相较现有扩散方法，ARPC 在超低码率下达到先进的感知保真度，并具备较高的解压效率。

All source code is available at https://github.com/Joanna-0421/ARPC.

全部源代码见 https://github.com/Joanna-0421/ARPC。

1 INTRODUCTION

1 引言

Neural image compression (Liu et al., 2023) has demonstrated superior performance than traditional methods (Wallace, 1991) for ultra-low bit compression tasks (Xia et al., 2025).

神经图像压缩（Liu 等，2023）在超低码率压缩任务（Xia 等，2025）中的表现已优于传统方法（Wallace，1991）。

Recently, generative models, such as GAN (Goodfellow et al., 2020) and diffusion model (Rombach et al., 2022), are explored for image compression at ultra-low bitrates and optimized for rate-distortion-perception (Blau & Michaeli, 2019), preserving texture details to improve human-perceptual performance.

近年来，GAN（Goodfellow 等，2020）和扩散模型（Rombach 等，2022）等生成模型被用于超低码率图像压缩，并针对码率–失真–感知权衡（Blau 和 Michaeli，2019）进行优化，以保留纹理细节并改善人眼感知效果。

Diffusion-based approaches have been proven to outperform GAN-based approaches for low bitrate image compression and achieve significant breakthroughs in the perceptual quality when decompressing.

基于扩散的方法已被证明在低码率图像压缩中优于基于 GAN 的方法，并在解压后的感知质量方面取得显著突破。

However, they still face three issues.

然而，它们仍面临三个问题。

  1. Limited bitrate adaptability.

1）码率适应性有限。

Most diffusion-based approaches (Careil et al., 2023; Li et al., 2024c; Xia et al., 2025) follow the one-model-per-rate training paradigm, which makes rate adaptation in real dynamic transmission environments difficult.

大多数扩散方法（Careil 等，2023；Li 等，2024c；Xia 等，2025）遵循每个码率单独训练一个模型的范式，难以适应实际传输环境中动态变化的码率。

  1. High encoding and decoding complexity.

2）编解码复杂度高。

Although recent works (Theis et al., 2022; Vonderfecht & Liu, 2025) have explored progressive coding by combining pretrained diffusion models and reverse channel coding, the diffusion models’ iterative denoising nature still introduces inevitable complexity.

尽管近期工作（Theis 等，2022；Vonderfecht 和 Liu，2025）尝试结合预训练扩散模型与反向信道编码实现渐进编码，但扩散模型迭代去噪的特性仍不可避免地带来计算开销。

  1. Infinite shared randomness.

3）无限的共享随机性。

The reverse channel coding requires that the sender and receiver must share randomness, which may not always be available (Lei et al., 2025).

反向信道编码要求发送端与接收端共享随机性，而这一条件并非总能满足（Lei 等，2025）。

In this paper, we aim to address above three issues via exploring using Visual AutoRegressive model (VAR) for image compression.

本文探索如何使用视觉自回归模型（VAR）进行图像压缩，以解决上述三个问题。

VAR’s next-scale prediction utilizes a multi-scale residual quantizer to encode an image into discrete, hierarchical visual tokens and later predict tokens progressively from coarse to fine in an autoregressive manner.

VAR 的下一尺度预测使用多尺度残差量化器将图像编码为离散、分层的视觉词元，再以自回归方式由粗到细逐步预测词元。

Thus, our first key insight is that this coarse-tofine paradigm naturally aligns with a perfect bitrate adaptability by transmitting coarse but crucial information first, such as layout, followed by progressively adding fine-grained texture details to gradually enhance image quality.

我们的第一个关键观察是，这种从粗到细的范式天然适合灵活调节码率：先传输布局等粗粒度但关键信息，再逐步加入细粒度纹理，以逐渐提高图像质量。

Then, compared with diffusion-based approaches, VAR has two additional advantages including faster generation process and no requirements for sharing randomness between the sender and receiver.

与扩散方法相比，VAR 还有两个优势：生成更快，且发送端与接收端不必共享随机性。

Figure 1: Qualitative comparison between ARPC and diffusion-based methods.

图 1：ARPC 与扩散方法的定性对比。

ARPC effectively reconstructs fine-grained textural details, while other methods exhibit noticeable texture loss.

ARPC 能有效重建细粒度纹理，其他方法则出现明显的纹理损失。

Motivated by the above insights, we explore the potential of VAR for ultra-low bitrate image compression tasks, and propose AutoRegressive-based Progressive Coding (ARPC), an efficient progressive image compression framework for ultra-low bitrate image compression.

受上述观察启发，我们探索 VAR 在超低码率图像压缩中的潜力，提出高效的渐进图像压缩框架 ARPC。

When compression, ARPC utilizes the bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer to directly encode the images into K bitstreams for transmission (K is the predefined number of scales for residual maps) and controls the bitrates by only transmitting the first k bitstreams.

压缩时，ARPC 使用逐比特多尺度残差量化器直接将图像编码为 K 条码流（K 是预先设定的残差图尺度数），仅传输前 k 条码流以控制码率。

To further improve the compression ratio, we utilize lossless entropy coding to re-encode the original bitstream based on the probability predicted by VAR and propose the group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer (GM-BMSRQ), which further compresses the coarse information into fewer bits.

为进一步提高压缩比，我们依据 VAR 预测的概率进行无损熵重编码，并提出分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器（GM-BMSRQ），用更少的比特编码粗粒度信息。

For decoding, ARPC leverages VAR to generate other K −k scale tokens in an autoregressive manner, naturally integrating the decompression task into the generative process of VAR, achieving progressive coding.

解码时，ARPC 使用 VAR 自回归生成其余 K−k 个尺度的词元，将解压自然融入 VAR 的生成过程，实现渐进编码。

We compare ARPC with 13 state-of-the-art baselines on two commonly used image compression testsets, considering 6 perceptual metrics.

我们在两个常用图像压缩测试集上将 ARPC 与 13 种先进基线进行比较，考察 6 项感知指标。

Extensive experiments prove that ARPC significantly outperforms baselines across different metrics on all datasets at ultra-low bitrates.

大量实验表明，在超低码率下，ARPC 在所有数据集的多项指标上均显著优于基线。

What’s more, ARPC achieves higher decompression efficiency, 2∼6× faster than diffusion-based methods.

此外，ARPC 的解压效率更高，速度为扩散方法的 2～6 倍。

Figure 1 illustrated that with the strong image prior of VAR, ARPC can achieve superior perceptual and statistical fidelity, effectively reconstructing fine-grained texture details with high realism.

图 1 表明，借助 VAR 强大的图像先验，ARPC 可取得更好的感知和统计保真度，真实地重建细粒度纹理。

2 RELATED WORKS

2 相关工作

2.1 NEURAL IMAGE COMPRESSION METHODS

2.1 神经图像压缩方法

Learned image compression methods have achieved remarkable rate-distortion performance compared to traditional image compression standards like JPEG (Wallace, 1991).

相较 JPEG 等传统图像压缩标准（Wallace，1991），学习式图像压缩在率失真性能方面取得显著成效。

Some methods focus on the coding process, considering the probability estimation accuracy to increase the compression ratio, by introducing hyperprior entropy model (Ballé et al., 2018), autoregressive context modeling (Minnen et al., 2018), a discrete Gaussian mixture model (Cheng et al., 2020), and spatial-channel contextual adaptive model (He et al., 2022a).

部分方法着眼于编码过程，通过引入超先验熵模型（Ballé 等，2018）、自回归上下文建模（Minnen 等，2018）、离散高斯混合模型（Cheng 等，2020）和空间–通道上下文自适应模型（He 等，2022a），提高概率估计精度和压缩比。

Other methods focus on optimizing the model architecture to improve feature extraction ability through well-designed modules, such as mixed transformer-CNN (Liu et al., 2023) and frequency-aware transformer (Li et al., 2023a).

另一些方法通过精心设计的模块来优化模型结构、增强特征提取能力，例如混合 Transformer–CNN（Liu 等，2023）和频率感知 Transformer（Li 等，2023a）。

Although the above VAE-based methods have achieved good performance, optimizing solely for mean square error (MSE) can lead to excessive image smoothing and low statistical fidelity at low bitrates.

尽管上述 VAE 方法已取得良好表现，但仅优化均方误差（MSE）容易在低码率下导致图像过度平滑和统计保真度下降。

(Blau & Michaeli, 2019) proposes to add a perceptual term in loss function to align well with human perception,

Blau 和 Michaeli（2019）提出在损失函数中加入感知项，使结果更符合人眼感知；

which is used in many recent works (Mentzer et al., 2020; Muckley et al., 2023; He et al., 2022b), combining generative adversarial network and a perceptual loss term.

许多后续工作将生成对抗网络与感知损失相结合（Mentzer 等，2020；Muckley 等，2023；He 等，2022b）。

Due to the strong prior of images and robust language understanding, text-to-image diffusion model (Rombach et al., 2022) has been explored for image compression tasks (Zhang et al., 2024; 2025b) and further improves the image fidelity and semantic consistency at ultra-low bitrates.

凭借强大的图像先验和语言理解能力，文本到图像扩散模型（Rombach 等，2022）也被用于图像压缩（Zhang 等，2024；2025b），进一步提高超低码率下的图像保真度和语义一致性。

(Lei et al., 2023) transmits image caption and image sketch as conditions for ControlNet (Zhang et al., 2023), enabling the image compression at utral-low bitrates.

Lei 等（2023）传输图像描述和草图，作为 ControlNet（Zhang 等，2023）的条件，实现超低码率压缩。

(Li et al., 2024c) and (Xia et al., 2025) utilize pre-trained stable diffusion to reconstruct images under the guidance of latent VAE features or image-level and semantic-level control flow.

Li 等（2024c）和 Xia 等（2025）利用预训练的 Stable Diffusion，在 VAE 潜在特征或图像级与语义级控制流的引导下重建图像。

Although these methods significantly improve the image fidelity, they all suffer from long decoding time due to the large number of denoising steps.

尽管这些方法显著改善图像保真度，较多的去噪步仍造成较长的解码时间。

Recent works explore accelerating the decoding process by initiating denoising process from compressed latents (Li et al., 2025), dynamically aligning denoising steps with bitrates (Ke et al., 2025) and leveraging the distilled SD-Turbo prior for one-step reconstruction (Zhang et al., 2025a).

近期工作通过从压缩潜变量开始去噪（Li 等，2025）、随码率动态调整去噪步数（Ke 等，2025）以及利用蒸馏后的 SD-Turbo 先验进行单步重建（Zhang 等，2025a）来加快解码。

All above methods need to train separate models for each bitrate, making rate adaptation difficult.

上述方法都需要按码率分别训练模型，难以适应码率变化。

(Theis et al., 2022) proposes DiffC to transmit the intermediate corrupted version of the diffusion process to achieve progressive compression based on reverse channel coding, assuming that shared randomness exists between the encoder and the decoder.

Theis 等（2022）提出 DiffC，通过传输扩散过程中的中间受扰动样本，基于反向信道编码实现渐进压缩，前提是编解码器之间存在共享随机性。

(Vonderfecht & Liu, 2025) further improves the DiffC algorithm and gives the first complete implementation considering the computational complexity of reverse channel coding, but still suffers from long compression and decompression time.

Vonderfecht 和 Liu（2025）改进 DiffC，在考虑反向信道编码复杂度的基础上给出了首个完整实现，但压缩和解压时间仍然较长。

2.2 DISCRETE VISUAL TOKENIZATION

2.2 离散视觉词元化

VQVAE (Van Den Oord et al., 2017) first introduces the concept of discrete latent space, transforming the continuous representation into discrete vectors using a trainable codebook.

VQVAE（Van Den Oord 等，2017）率先提出离散潜在空间，用可训练码本将连续表示转换为离散向量。

With further development, such as LFQ (Yu et al., 2023), BSQ (Zhao et al., 2024), and residual vector quantization (Zeghidour et al., 2021), discrete visual tokenization has also been widely used for compression tasks,

随着 LFQ（Yu 等，2023）、BSQ（Zhao 等，2024）和残差向量量化（Zeghidour 等，2021）等方法的发展，离散视觉词元化也广泛用于

such as audio compression (Zeghidour et al., 2021), image compression (Careil et al., 2023; Mao et al., 2024; Guo et al., 2025), and video compression (Tian et al., 2023).

音频压缩（Zeghidour 等，2021）、图像压缩（Careil 等，2023；Mao 等，2024；Guo 等，2025）与视频压缩（Tian 等，2023）。

By transmitting the indices of discrete vectors, the compression methods based on codebooks can not only control the upper bound of bitrates (Careil et al., 2023) but also avoid inconsistent probability distribution estimation problems in cross-platform scenarios (Tian et al., 2023).

基于码本的方法通过传输离散向量索引，既能控制码率上限（Careil 等，2023），也可避免跨平台场景下概率分布估计不一致的问题（Tian 等，2023）。

However, to ensure the low bitrate, the vocabulary size of the codebooks is often small, which can’t cover all image features, resulting in suboptimal compression performance and low perceptual fidelity.

不过，为保持低码率，码本词表通常较小，难以覆盖全部图像特征，因而压缩性能和感知保真度均受限。

2.3 VISUAL AUTOREGRESSIVE MODELS

2.3 视觉自回归模型

Driven by the great success of LLMs (Brown et al., 2020; Touvron et al., 2023), visual autoregressive models utilize discrete visual tokenizers, such as VQVAE (Van Den Oord et al., 2017), to convert image patches into index-wise tokens,

受大语言模型（LLM）成功的推动（Brown 等，2020；Touvron 等，2023），视觉自回归模型采用 VQVAE（Van Den Oord 等，2017）等离散视觉词元器，将图像块转成以索引表示的词元，

generating images based on next-token prediction (Lee et al., 2022; Wang et al., 2024) or next-scale prediction (Tian et al., 2024; Han et al., 2025).

再通过下一词元预测（Lee 等，2022；Wang 等，2024）或下一尺度预测（Tian 等，2024；Han 等，2025）生成图像。

Based on next-scale prediction, VAR (Tian et al., 2024) makes the autoregressive model surpass diffusion transformers (Peebles & Xie, 2023) for the first time, considering image quality, inference speed, and scalability.

基于下一尺度预测，VAR（Tian 等，2024）首次使自回归模型在图像质量、推理速度和扩展性方面超越扩散 Transformer（Peebles 和 Xie，2023）。

Infinity (Han et al., 2025) further proposes bitwise modeling using BSQ (Zhao et al., 2024), improving the scaling and visual detail representation capabilities of VAR.

Infinity（Han 等，2025）进一步使用 BSQ（Zhao 等，2024）进行逐比特建模，增强 VAR 的扩展能力和视觉细节表示能力。

VAR has also been further expanded to other tasks, such as conditional generation (Li et al., 2024b), image restoration (Wang et al., 2025), and image super-resolution (Qu et al., 2025), demonstrating the potential of VAR for various tasks.

VAR 也已扩展到条件生成（Li 等，2024b）、图像复原（Wang 等，2025）和图像超分辨率（Qu 等，2025）等任务，显示出多用途潜力。

However, to the best of our knowledge, the potential of VAR for image compression task remains unexplored.

不过，据我们所知，VAR 用于图像压缩的潜力尚未得到探索。

3 方法

In this section, we first introduce the preliminary of visual autoregressive model (section 3.1).

本节首先介绍视觉自回归模型的基础（第 3.1 节），

Then, we give the detailed explanation of the ARPC’s framework to achieve the progressive compression and decompression (section 3.2).

随后详述 ARPC 如何实现渐进压缩与解压（第 3.2 节）。

To improve the compression ratio, we use lossless entropy coding to re-encode the indices of the tokens (section 3.3).

为提高压缩比，我们使用无损熵编码对词元索引进行重编码（第 3.3 节）。

Based on the observation of visualization for different scale residual token maps, we propose group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer (GM-BMSRQ).

通过观察不同尺度残差词元图的可视化结果，我们提出 GM-BMSRQ，

This enhances the original quantizer by achieving a more compact representation at earlier scales, thus further improving the compression ratio at ultra-low bitrates (section 3.4).

使较早尺度的表示更加紧凑，从而进一步提高超低码率下的压缩比（第 3.4 节）。

Figure 2: Overview of ARPC. ARPC leverages coarse-to-fine generation paradigm of VAR to achieve progressive compression (section 3.2).

图 2：ARPC 总览。ARPC 利用 VAR 由粗到细的生成范式进行渐进压缩（第 3.2 节）。

ARPC encodes the image into K scale tokens and applies arithmetic coding for lossless compression based on the probability predicted by VAR (section 3.3).

ARPC 将图像编码为 K 个尺度的词元，再根据 VAR 预测的概率进行算术编码，实现无损压缩（第 3.3 节）。

To further improve the compression ratio, ARPC utilizes group masks to enhance the original quantizer to compress image into fewer bits (section 3.4).

为了进一步提高压缩比，ARPC 使用分组掩码增强原有量化器，使图像可用更少比特表示（第 3.4 节）。

3.1 PRELIMINARIES: VISUAL AUTOREGRESSIVE MODEL

3.1 预备知识：视觉自回归模型

We focus on the VAR based on next-scale prediction, where the basic unit of autoregression is the entire scale, containing a sequence of tokens.

我们关注基于下一尺度预测的 VAR，其自回归基本单位是包含一列词元的整个尺度。

For an image x, the image encoder first encodes x into a feature map F∈Rh×w×c, and then quantize the feature map F into K scale residual maps, denoted as (R1,R2,…,RK).

对图像 x，图像编码器先生成特征图 F∈Rh×w×c，再将其量化为 K 个尺度的残差图 (R1,R2,…,RK)。

The resolution of Rk, (hk×wk), grows larger gradually from k=1→K.

随 k 从 1 增至 K，Rk 的分辨率 hk×wk 逐渐增大。

Each scale corresponds to hk×wk tokens.

每个尺度对应 hk×wk 个词元；

For simplicity, we use scale tokens to denote the sequence of tokens of each scale.

为简便起见，以下用“尺度词元”指每个尺度的词元序列。

We denote Fk as the cumulative sum of the upsampled R≤k: Fk=∑i=1kupsample(Ri,(h,w)).

令 Fk 为 R≤k 上采样后的累积和，即 Fk=∑i=1kupsample(Ri,(h,w))。

As k increases, Fk gradually approximates the continuous feature map F.

随着 k 增大，Fk 逐步逼近连续特征图 F。

Such quantization method ensures a coarse-to-fine paradigm, with earlier scales presenting the crucial structural information, while the subsequent scales progressively add finer details.

这种量化由粗到细，早期尺度给出关键结构，后续尺度逐步补充更精细的细节。

We give the visualization of Fk in Figure 2.

图 2 给出了 Fk 的可视化。

Inspired by Infinity (Han et al., 2025), we use bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer, where ri,j=Rk(i,j)=1csign(ri,j|ri,j|).

受 Infinity（Han 等，2025）启发，我们采用逐比特多尺度残差量化器，其中 ri,j=Rk(i,j)=1csign(ri,j|ri,j|)。

In the discrete latent space, the VAR learns to predict the next scale tokens Rk+1 conditioned on previous scale tokens R≤k and text input t, which can be formulated as:

在离散潜在空间中，VAR 学习根据先前的尺度词元 R≤k 与文本输入 t 预测下一尺度词元 Rk+1，可写为：

(1)p(R1,R2,…,RK)=∏i=1Kp(Rk∣R1,…,Rk−1,C),

where C is the text embedding, which is also projected into the beginning token <SOS>,

其中，C 是文本嵌入，也被投影为起始词元 <SOS>。

and p∈Rhk×wk×c×2 is predicted by c binary classifiers, presenting the probability of next scale tokens.

p∈Rhk×wk×c×2 由 c 个二分类器预测，表示下一尺度词元的概率。

3.2 PROGRESSIVE COMPRESSION WITH AUTOREGRESSIVE FRAMEWORK

3.2 基于自回归框架的渐进压缩

The basic idea behind our method is based on the coarse-to-fine paradigm, which prioritizes the transmission of crucial data, the earlier scale tokens of the multi-scale residual quantizer.

我们的方法基于由粗到细的范式，优先传输多尺度残差量化器的早期尺度词元，即关键信息。

To achieve this, ARPC only transmits the first k scale tokens and generates other K −k scale tokens by VAR, leveraging the generation capacity to add finer details, reconstructing high realism images.

ARPC 只传输前 k 个尺度的词元，并利用 VAR 的生成能力生成其余 K−k 个尺度的词元，补充精细细节并重建逼真的图像。

Note that ARPC can achieve progressive coding through selecting different k scales for transmission, which enables the single compression model to support multiple bitrates.

通过选择不同的 k 值，ARPC 实现渐进编码，使单一压缩模型支持多个码率。

At the sender end, we encode an image x based on bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer, as shown in Figure 2, E(x)=(R1,R2,…,RK).

在发送端，我们使用逐比特多尺度残差量化器编码图像 x，如图 2 所示，E(x)=(R1,R2,…,RK)。

Unlike transmitting the index of codebook in token-based methods (Careil et al., 2023; Guo et al., 2025), bitwise quantizer maps each c-dimensional vector to a c-bit binary code (i.e. 1 for positive, 0 otherwise), which can naturally be considered as bitstreams.

与传输码本索引的词元方法（Careil 等，2023；Guo 等，2025）不同，逐比特量化器将每个 c 维向量映射为 c 位二进制码（正值为 1，其余为 0），可以直接视为码流。

The k-th scale tokens, Rk, naively needs hk×wk×c bits for transmission.

朴素传输第 k 个尺度的词元 Rk 需要 hk×wk×c 比特。

What’s more, we use BLIP2 model (Li et al., 2023b) to generate an image caption t as a global semantic context, transmitted to the receiver end along with the first k scale tokens.

此外，我们用 BLIP2（Li 等，2023b）生成图像描述 t，将其作为全局语义上下文，与前 k 个尺度的词元一同传至接收端。

At the receiver end, we get the first k scale tokens R≤k, and use them as the prefixed content to predict R^>k through K−k autoregressive processes.

在接收端，取得前 k 个尺度的词元 R≤k 后，将它们作为前缀，通过 K−k 次自回归预测得到 R^>k。

All K scale tokens are upsampled into the same resolution and concatenated together, then input into the image decoder D to get the reconstructed image xk=D((R1,…,Rk,R^k+1,…,R^K)).

所有 K 个尺度的词元均上采样至相同分辨率，拼接后输入图像解码器 D，得到重建图像 xk=D((R1,…,Rk,R^k+1,…,R^K))。

To get a better reconstruction quality, we analyze the distortion of the reconstructed image xk (k denotes only the first k scale tokens transmission between sender and receiver) and demonstrate that the distortion Dk=d(x,xk) has an upper bound:

为改善重建质量，我们分析重建图像 xk 的失真（此处 k 表示发送端与接收端之间仅传输了前 k 个尺度的词元），并证明失真 Dk=d(x,xk) 存在上界：

Theorem 3.1. Given an input image x, encoder E, decoder D.

定理 3.1。给定输入图像 x、编码器 E 和解码器 D。

Let (R≤k,R>k)=E(x) be the ground truth tokens and xK=D((R≤k,R>k)) be the reconstructed image from ground-truth tokens, with distortion DK=d(x,xK).

设 (R≤k,R>k)=E(x) 为真实词元，xK=D((R≤k,R>k)) 为用真实词元得到的重建图像，失真为 DK=d(x,xK)。

Let R^>k be the tokens predicted by VAR based on R≤k, and xk=D((R≤k,R^>k)) be the final reconstruction, with distortion Dk=d(x,xk).

设 R^>k 是 VAR 基于 R≤k 预测的词元，xk=D((R≤k,R^>k)) 为最终重建，失真为 Dk=d(x,xk)。

We have:

有：

(2)E[Dk]≤E[DK]+C⋅ER≤k[DKL(p(R>k∣R≤k)∥pθ(R>k∣R≤k))].

See the proof in Appendix A.1.

证明见附录 A.1。

It indicates the distortion can be optimized by minimizing two key components: 1) the reconstruction error between the original image and the image decoded from ground-truth tokens, and 2) the KL divergence between the true and predicted distributions of the scale tokens.

该上界表明，可通过最小化两个关键部分来优化失真：1）原始图像与由真实词元解码的图像之间的重建误差；2）尺度词元的真实分布与预测分布之间的 KL 散度。

Thus, the training has two stages.

因此，训练分为两个阶段。

First, we train image encoder, decoder, and quantizer to minimize the first distortion term in Equation 2, following:

首先训练图像编码器、解码器和量化器，最小化式（2）中的第一项失真：

(3)Lfirst=Lrec+Lper+Ldis+Lcommit+Lentropy,

where Lrec is the L1 loss between reconstructed image xK and input image x, Lper is the perceptual loss, Ldis is the discriminator loss,

其中，Lrec 是重建图像 xK 与输入图像 x 之间的 L1 损失，Lper 是感知损失，Ldis 是判别器损失，

Lcommit is MSE loss in the discrete latent space and Lentropy is the entropy loss used for bitwise quantizer (Zhao et al., 2024).

Lcommit 是离散潜在空间中的 MSE 损失，Lentropy 是逐比特量化器的熵损失（Zhao 等，2024）。

Second, we optimize the VAR to minimize the KL divergence between the true and predicted distribution, following:

其次，优化 VAR，最小化真实分布与预测分布之间的 KL 散度：

(4)LVAR=−∑i=1Klog⁡pθ(Ri∣R<i).

3.3 LOSSLESS RE-ENCODING FOR DISCRETE INDICES

3.3 离散索引的无损重编码

To further improve the compression ratio, (Careil et al., 2023) assumes that the token indices satisfy a uniform distribution for lossless entropy coding.

为进一步提高压缩比，Careil 等（2023）假设词元索引服从均匀分布，以进行无损熵编码。

Different from the vector quantizer, bitwise quantizer index each token using a binary code, denoted as yk(i,j)=∑n=0c−11Rk(i,j,n)>02n, where i, j is the spatial coordinate and n is the channel coordinate of the k scale tokens.

与向量量化器不同，逐比特量化器使用二进制码表示每个词元的索引，即 yk(i,j)=∑n=0c−11Rk(i,j,n)>02n，其中 i,j 是空间坐标，n 是第 k 个尺度词元的通道坐标。

However, each element of yk(i,j) doesn’t satisfy the uniform distribution (i.e., 0.5 for 1 and 0.5 for 0), as they represent semantic information of the image and are therefore dependent on the previous context.

各比特并非均匀分布（0 和 1 的概率并非均为 0.5），因为它们表示图像语义，因而依赖先前的上下文。

Interestingly, we notice that the learning objective of the VAR is to accurately predict such distribution conditioned on previous scales, as illustrated in section 3.1.

值得注意的是，如第 3.1 节所述，VAR 的学习目标正是在先前尺度的条件下准确预测这种分布。

This provides the potential for more effective entropy coding, as the distributions are highly accurate.

预测的准确性为更有效的熵编码提供了可能。

At the sender end, we target the VAR as a probability estimator, which uses c binary classifiers to predict c independent distributions for each token, denoted as pk(i,j)∈Rc×2.

在发送端，我们将 VAR 用作概率估计器，使用 c 个二分类器预测每个词元的 c 个独立分布，记为 pk(i,j)∈Rc×2。

We use arithmetic coding (the details can be found in Appendix A.3), a lossless entropy coding, to further compress the token indices based on pk.

我们根据 pk 使用无损的算术编码进一步压缩词元索引（详见附录 A.3）。

For compression, we follow the autoregressive process. First, we use the beginning token <SOS> to predict the probability of the first scale, p1, to encode the indices y1.

压缩遵循自回归过程：先用起始词元 <SOS> 预测第一个尺度的概率 p1，编码索引 y1；

Then, the bit indices of each scale can be encoded by the probability predicted VAR conditioned on previous scales until all k scale indices are encoded in an autoregressive manner.

再使用 VAR 基于先前尺度预测的概率编码各尺度的比特索引，直至以自回归方式编码完前 k 个尺度。

The decompression can be divided into two stages: the lossless decompression and lossy decompression.

解压分为无损与有损两个阶段。

The lossless decompression is the same as the compression process, predicting the probability of each scale tokens from the first to the k-th, and using arithmetic decoding for lossless decompression.

无损解压与压缩采用同样的概率预测过程，从第一个尺度预测至第 k 个尺度，并通过算术解码无损恢复词元。

For lossy decompression, we leverage the generation capacity of VAR and use classifier free guidance on predicted logits to generate K −k scale tokens to get the final decompressed image.

有损解压则利用 VAR 的生成能力，在预测 logits 上采用无分类器引导，生成其余 K−k 个尺度的词元，得到最终解压图像。

3.4 GROUP-MASKED BITWISE MULTI-SCALE RESIDUAL QUANTIZER

3.4 分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器

ARPC achieves ultra-low bitrate compression by transmitting only the first few scale tokens.

ARPC 通过仅传输前几个尺度的词元实现超低码率压缩。

The first few scale tokens contain the image’s most crucial coarse-grained information, such as the image structure and color.

这些词元包含图像结构和颜色等最关键的粗粒度信息。

Although crucial, they are low-frequency information with less detail, which can be compressed into a smaller feature space.

尽管关键，这些信息属于细节较少的低频信息，可以压缩到更小的特征空间。

Bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer downsamples the feature maps from spatial dimension to create less tokens.

逐比特多尺度残差量化器在空间维度下采样特征图，以减少词元数。

Inspired by the product quantization (Guo et al., 2024), which divides a high-dimensional vector into several low-dimensional tokens using different quantizers,

受乘积量化（Guo 等，2024）用不同量化器将高维向量划分为多个低维词元的启发，

we propose to enhance the bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer with group masks, compressing the feature space of the first few scales considering both resolution and channel dimension, to further increase the compression ratio at ultra-low bitrates.

我们在逐比特多尺度残差量化器中加入分组掩码，同时从分辨率与通道维度压缩早期尺度的特征空间，进一步提高超低码率下的压缩比。

First, we observe each scale, noting that they have a clear hierarchy and can be broadly divided into three groups, as shown in Figure 2.

首先，我们观察了各尺度，发现它们具有明显的层次，约可分为三组，如图 2 所示。

The first four scales present large color blocks, establishing the macro color layout of the image.

前四个尺度呈现大色块，建立图像的整体色彩布局。

The subsequent five scales begin to show the basic outlines and structure of objects, but still lack details, resulting in the blurriness of edges.

随后五个尺度开始表现物体的基本轮廓与结构，但仍缺少细节，边缘模糊。

The last four scales significantly improve the fine textures of the images.

最后四个尺度显著改善图像的精细纹理。

Based on our observation, we divide K scales into three groups and propose group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer (GM-BMSRQ), masking the channels of scale tokens.

根据该观察，我们把 K 个尺度分为三组，提出 GM-BMSRQ，对尺度词元的通道施加掩码。

For a feature map F∈Rh×w×c, with the original scale tokens Rk∈Rhk×wk×c, we mask the last c/2 channels for the first group, setting to -1 as inactive bits, and the last c/4 for the second group.

对特征图 F∈Rh×w×c 及原始尺度词元 Rk∈Rhk×wk×c，我们屏蔽第一组最后 c/2 个通道，将其设为 −1 作为非活跃比特；第二组则屏蔽最后 c/4 个通道。

Such method adaptively creates a more compact representation of information based on the content of each scale, while further reducing the number of bits required for the transmission of the first two groups.

该方法根据各尺度的内容自适应形成更紧凑的表示，进一步减少前两组的传输比特数。

Besides reducing the token bit number, a smaller value of k leads to a lower bitrate.

除了减少词元比特数，减小 k 也能降低码率。

However, (Li et al., 2024a) reveals that the image semantics are concentrated in the final few scale tokens,

不过，Li 等（2024a）发现图像语义集中于最后几个尺度。

which means that if we only transmit the first few scale tokens, the receiver will get little useful information for decompression, resulting in low reconstructed image quality at low bitrates.

这意味着只传输早期尺度时，接收端能够用于解压的信息很少，导致低码率下重建质量下降。

To solve this problem, we apply scale random dropout (SRD) strategy during training to enhance the semantic information preservation in the earlier scale tokens, retaining more semantic information at ultra-low bitrates.

为解决该问题，我们在训练中使用尺度随机丢弃（SRD）策略，增强早期尺度保留语义信息的能力，使超低码率下也能保留更多语义信息。

4 EXPERIMENTS

4 实验

4.1 EXPERIMENT SETUP

4.1 实验设置

Datasets. We use Coyo-700M (Byeon et al., 2022), a large-scale image-text pair dataset, as our training dataset. We curated our training dataset through a multi-stage pipeline.

数据集。我们使用大规模图文对数据集 Coyo-700M（Byeon 等，2022）训练，通过多阶段流程筛选训练数据。

We first select images with a resolution greater than 1024×1024, and then exploit an OCR model to filter undesired images with too much text.

首先选择分辨率高于 1024×1024 的图像，再用 OCR 模型剔除文字过多的图像，

Finally, we utilize the advanced InternVL 2.0 model (Gao et al., 2024) to re-caption all filtered images to provide more accurate and detailed annotations.

最后使用 InternVL 2.0（Gao 等，2024）为筛选后的图像重新生成描述，提供更准确、详细的标注。

Our final training dataset includes 5M highly curated images with detailed captions.

最终的训练集包含 500 万幅经严格筛选且具有详细描述的图像。

For evaluation, we validate ARPC on two widely used image compression benchmark datasets: DIV2K-val (Agustsson & Timofte, 2017) and CLIC2020 (Toderici et al., 2020), which consist of 100 and 428 high-definition images, with the captions generated by BLIP2 model.

评估使用两个常见的图像压缩基准：DIV2K-val（Agustsson 和 Timofte，2017）和 CLIC2020（Toderici 等，2020），分别包含 100 幅和 428 幅高清图像，描述由 BLIP2 生成。

We reference (Xia et al., 2025; Guo et al., 2025) to center-crop all original images to 1024×1024 resolution for evaluation.

参考 Xia 等（2025）和 Guo 等（2025），我们对所有原始图像进行中心裁剪，以 1024×1024 分辨率评估。

As Kodak lacks extensive validation, we present the experimental results in Appendix A.4.

由于 Kodak 的验证规模有限，其实验结果放在附录 A.4。

Model training details. The training has two stages.

模型训练细节。训练分为两个阶段。

First, we train the image encoder and decoder with the group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer, which is configured with three groups using channel dimensions of 8, 12, and 16, respectively.

首先训练图像编码器、解码器和分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器，量化器三组的通道维度分别为 8、12 和 16。

The training begins with 500k iterations on 256×256 images, followed by an additional 300k iterations on a mix of 256×256, 512×512, and 1024×1024 resolutions.

先在 256×256 图像上训练 50 万次迭代，再用 256×256、512×512 和 1024×1024 混合分辨率继续训练 30 万次迭代。

The scale random dropout strategy is used with a probability of 0.2 and applied from the fourth scale.

从第四个尺度开始，以 0.2 的概率使用尺度随机丢弃策略。

In the second stage, we freeze the image encoder and decoder, use Infinity-2B as the visual autoregressive model,

在第二阶段，冻结图像编解码器，采用 Infinity-2B 作为视觉自回归模型，

and finetune it for 20k iterations using the AdamW optimizer with a batch size of 64 and a learning rate of 6 × 10−5 on 1024×1024 images with text captioned by InternVL 2.0 model.

以带有 InternVL 2.0 文本描述的 1024×1024 图像微调 2 万次迭代。优化器为 AdamW，批大小为 64，学习率为 6×10−5。

All experiments are performed on 8× NVIDIA H20 GPUs.

所有实验使用 8 张 NVIDIA H20 GPU。

Metrics. We focus more on perceptual quality at ultra-low bitrates following previous works (Xia et al., 2025; Vonderfecht & Liu, 2025) and select 6 perceptual metrics for quantitative measures.

指标。与已有工作（Xia 等，2025；Vonderfecht 和 Liu，2025）一致，我们更关注超低码率下的感知质量，并选用 6 项感知指标定量评估。

For perceptual similarity comparison, we consider LPIPS (Zhang et al., 2018) and DISTS (Ding et al., 2020).

感知相似性采用 LPIPS（Zhang 等，2018）和 DISTS（Ding 等，2020）；

For human-centric visual quality comparison, we consider PIEAPP (Prashnani et al., 2018), focusing on human preference for perceptual fidelity, and CLIP Score (Hessel et al., 2021), focusing on high-level semantic content comparison.

面向人眼的视觉质量采用 PIEAPP（Prashnani 等，2018）和 CLIP Score（Hessel 等，2021），前者反映人对感知保真度的偏好，后者考察高级语义内容；

For overall distribution comparison, we consider FID (Heusel et al., 2017) and KID (Bińkowski et al., 2018), which capture the statistical fidelity between compressed and original images.

整体分布比较采用 FID（Heusel 等，2017）和 KID（Bińkowski 等，2018），衡量压缩图像相对于原始图像的统计保真度。

Baselines. We compare ARPC with several state-of-the-art neural compression schemes, including VAE-based, diffusion-based, and token-based methods.

基线。我们将 ARPC 与多种先进的神经压缩方案比较，包括基于 VAE、扩散和词元的方法。

For VAE-based methods, we consider ELIC (He et al., 2022a), optimizing for rate-distortion and MS-ILLM (Muckley et al., 2023), optimizing for rate-distortion-perception.

VAE 方法包括优化率失真的 ELIC（He 等，2022a）以及优化码率–失真–感知的 MS-ILLM（Muckley 等，2023）。

For diffusion-based methods, we consider DiffEIC (Li et al., 2024c), DiffPC (Xia et al., 2025), RDEIC Li et al. (2025), ResULIC Ke et al. (2025), StableCodec Zhang et al. (2025a) and OSCAR Guo et al. (2025),

扩散方法包括 DiffEIC（Li 等，2024c）、DiffPC（Xia 等，2025）、RDEIC（Li 等，2025）、ResULIC（Ke 等，2025）、StableCodec（Zhang 等，2025a）和 OSCAR（Guo 等，2025），

which are all based on a pre-trained diffusion model to reconstruct images conditioned on the decoded content variables.

均以解码后的内容变量作为条件，借助预训练扩散模型重建图像。

Furthermore, we consider DiffC (Vonderfecht & Liu, 2025), which is also a progressive compression method by transmitting the corrupted version of diffusion process. We use the DiffC based on the pretrained Flux-dev model.

我们还考察 DiffC（Vonderfecht 和 Liu，2025），它通过传输扩散过程中的受扰动样本进行渐进压缩；所用 DiffC 基于预训练 Flux-dev。

Token-based methods include VQGAN (Mao et al., 2024), GLC Qi et al. (2025) and DLF Xue et al. (2025).

词元方法包括 VQGAN（Mao 等，2024）、GLC（Qi 等，2025）和 DLF（Xue 等，2025）。

For all baselines, we retrain their models with our training dataset using their open-source code and default settings, achieving performance consistent with the original results.

我们采用各基线的开源代码和默认设置在自己的训练集上重新训练，得到与原报告一致的性能。

Figure 3: Quantitative comparisons with SOTA methods on the DIV2K and CLIC2020 datasets.

图 3：在 DIV2K 和 CLIC2020 数据集上与先进方法的定量比较。

4.2 MAIN RESULTS

4.2 主要结果

Quantitative comparisons. Figure 3 show the comparison results on DIV2K validation set and CLIC2020 test set.

定量比较。图 3 展示了 DIV2K 验证集和 CLIC2020 测试集上的比较结果。

The results demonstrate that ARPC consistently outperforms most baseline solutions across all transmission rates, especially at ultra-low bitrates.

ARPC 在各传输码率下持续优于大多数基线，优势在超低码率下尤其明显。

Furthermore, ARPC significantly outperforms all baselines as measured by the FID and KID metrics, demonstrating our approach’s excellent capacity for preserving statistical fidelity.

ARPC 的 FID 和 KID 显著优于所有基线，表明其具有良好的统计保真度。

We attribute this superiority over diffusion-based methods to the powerful generative capabilities inherent in autoregressive-based architecture.

我们将相较扩散方法的优势归因于自回归架构的生成能力。

Compared to DiffC, a diffusion-based progressive codec, ARPC outperforms it across all bitrates without the need for shared randomness due to latent feature discretization.

与基于扩散的渐进编解码器 DiffC 相比，ARPC 在各码率下均更优，并且由于将潜在特征离散化，无需共享随机性。

Compared to token-based methods, which also utilize discrete token indices for transmission, ARPC achieves significantly better performance.

与同样传输离散词元索引的方法相比，ARPC 的性能也显著更好，

This is due to two main factors: ARPC utilizes a larger codebook that covers more comprehensive image features, controlling bitrates by transmitting different numbers of scales, but not the vocabulary size of the codebook.

主要有两个原因：ARPC 使用更大的码本覆盖更丰富的图像特征，以传输尺度数量而非码本词表大小来控制码率；

What’s more, ARPC leverages VAR to more accurately predict the distribution of token indices, further increasing the compression ratio.

此外，ARPC 利用 VAR 更准确地预测词元索引分布，进一步提高压缩比。

Qualitative comparisons. We provide qualitative comparisons in Figure 4, which shows the visual results at ultra-low bitrates (<0.01 bpp), and Figure 5, which shows the image detail comparison at higher bitrates.

定性比较。图 4 展示超低码率（<0.01 bpp）下的视觉效果，图 5 对比更高码率下的图像细节。

To ensure low bitrates, PerCo and OSCAR uses a vocabulary size of 256, which can only cover simple image features.

为保持低码率，PerCo 和 OSCAR 使用大小为 256 的词表，只能覆盖较简单的图像特征。

As illustrated in Figure 4, for a simple image, such as a squirrel, PerCo can preserve the basic shape and semantics, but fails to reconstruct the original colors.

如图 4 所示，对于松鼠等简单图像，PerCo 能保留基本形状与语义，却未能重建原始颜色；

For more complex images, however, PerCo and OSCAR are unable to retain the original semantic information.

对于更复杂的图像，PerCo 和 OSCAR 无法保留原始语义信息。

DiffC and StableCodec successfully reconstructs the basic structure and semantic content of the image, but it suffers from a loss of fine details, such as the face of the human or the pin in the cup.

DiffC 和 StableCodec 能重建基本结构与语义，却会丢失人物面部、杯中别针等精细细节。

ARPC maintains a higher similarity in structure, semantics, and details, resulting in significant visual improvements.

ARPC 在结构、语义和细节上与原图更接近，显著改善了视觉效果。

At higher bitrates, ARPC demonstrates a superior capability in reconstructing high-frequency details.

在更高码率下，ARPC 表现出更强的高频细节重建能力。

As shown in Figure 5, competing methods like MS-ILLM and OSCAR exhibit various degrees of blurring or structural distortion.

如图 5 所示，MS-ILLM 和 OSCAR 等方法存在不同程度的模糊或结构失真，

In contrast, ARPC successfully preserves fine-grained textures, such as the delicate patterns and the speckles of light on leaves, demonstrating the remarkably superior visual quality and realism of ARPC with minimal bitrates.

而 ARPC 保留了细致花纹、叶片上的光斑等精细纹理，表明其能以很低的码率重建更逼真、视觉质量更高的图像。

Figure 4: Visual comparison of generative compression methods at ultra-low bitrates (<0.01bpp).

图 4：生成式压缩方法在超低码率（<0.01 bpp）下的视觉对比。

SC denotes the StableCodec.

SC 表示 StableCodec。

Figure 5: Qualitative illustrations of various methods on DIV2K and CLIC2020 datasets.

图 5：不同方法在 DIV2K 和 CLIC2020 数据集上的定性结果。

Computational complexity compared with diffusion-based methods. VAR achieves high generation efficiency by adopting a hierarchical generation strategy with a small number of iterations.

与扩散方法的计算复杂度比较。VAR 采用分层生成策略，以较少迭代实现高效生成。

Thus, ARPC significantly reduces the decoding latency compared to the diffusion-based methods, which need longer inference time due to multi-step denoising process.

扩散方法需要多步去噪、推理时间较长，而 ARPC 显著降低了解码延迟。

As shown in Table 1, ARPC only requires 5.39s to decompress an image, which is twice as fast as PerCo and 2∼6× faster than DiffC.

如表 1 所示，ARPC 解压一幅图像仅需 5.39 秒，约为 PerCo 的两倍速度，为 DiffC 的 2～6 倍。

Compared with one-step diffusion based methods, such as StableCodec, although ARPC requires more decoding time, the most significant advantage of ARPC is the progressive coding, which can not be achieved by the one-step diffusion based method.

与 StableCodec 等单步扩散方法相比，ARPC 虽然解码更耗时，却能实现单步扩散方法无法提供的渐进编码。

Different from DiffC, which can initiate generation from an arbitrary denoising step, AR-based model predicts the k + 1-th scale depending on the first k scales.

DiffC 可以从任意去噪步开始生成，自回归模型则依据前 k 个尺度预测第 k+1 个尺度。

Consequently, ARPC starts decoding process from the beginning token and completes a predefined number of steps to decode an image, resulting in a deterministic decoding time rather than a variable range.

因此，ARPC 从起始词元开始，以预定步数解码图像，解码时间是确定值。

For encoding, due to ARPC targets the VAR as a probability predictor, transmitting k scales tokens requires predicting the probability distribution of the first k scale tokens for arithmetic coding.

编码方面，ARPC 用 VAR 预测概率，因此传输前 k 个尺度需要先预测其分布以进行算术编码。

Thus, the encoding time is variable, increasing with higher bitrates.

编码时间随码率上升而增加。

Unlike diffusion-based methods, which exhibit a consistent computational cost per iteration, the complexity of ARPC’s encoding process is very low at low bitrates with fewer token counts at early scales (refer to Appendix A.7 for more details).

扩散方法每步的计算成本较稳定，而 ARPC 的早期尺度词元较少，低码率下的编码复杂度很低（详见附录 A.7）。

Table 1: Inference efficiency and BD-rate (%) comparison on CLIC2020 dataset (1024×1024).

表 1：CLIC2020（1024×1024）上的推理效率和 BD-rate（%）对比。

4.3 ABLATION STUDY

4.3 消融实验

In this section, we conduct the ablation study by removing LRE (lossless re-encoding), SRD (scale random dropout), and GM-BMSRQ (group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer), and the quantitative results are shown in Figure 7.

本节通过移除 LRE（无损重编码）、SRD（尺度随机丢弃）和 GM-BMSRQ（分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器）进行消融实验，定量结果见图 7。

Since both the LRE and the group mask for the BMSRQ are used to improve the compression ratio with little impact on the decompressed image quality, we only present the visual results without SRD, as illustrated in Figure 6.

LRE 和 BMSRQ 的分组掩码均旨在提高压缩比，对解压图像质量的影响较小，因此图 6 仅展示去掉 SRD 后的视觉结果。

Figure 6: Visual comparison with and without scale random dropout strategy.

图 6：使用与不使用尺度随机丢弃策略时的视觉对比。

Figure 7: Ablation study on the DIV2K dataset.

图 7：DIV2K 数据集上的消融实验。

W/o LRE. To demonstrate that the lossless entropy re-encoding based on the probability predicted by the VAR can efficiently reduce the bitrates, we remove the arithmetic coding and directly transmit the binary code quantized by the GM-BMSRQ.

不使用 LRE。为验证基于 VAR 预测概率的无损熵重编码能够有效降低码率，我们移除算术编码，直接传输 GM-BMSRQ 量化得到的二进制码。

As shown in Figure 7, a bitrate reduction of approximately 30% can be achieved by applying arithmetic coding, without any impact on image quality.

如图 7 所示，采用算术编码可降低约 30% 的码率，且不影响图像质量。

Without the computational overhead of autoregressive probability prediction, the encoding time is significantly reduced, requiring only 0.2 seconds, as shown in Table 1.

去掉自回归概率预测的计算开销后，编码耗时显著缩短，如表 1 所示，仅需 0.2 秒。

W/o SRD. To show that scale random dropout strategy can enhance the representation capability of earlier scales, improving the fidelity of reconstructed images at low bitrates.

不使用 SRD。为验证尺度随机丢弃策略能增强早期尺度的表示能力、改善低码率下的重建保真度，

We remove such strategy during the first stage training, and results are shown in Figure 7.

我们在第一阶段训练中移除该策略，结果见图 7。

The results show that SRD plays an important role in decompressing images to get better perceptual metrics, especially at low bitrates.

SRD 有助于改善解压图像的感知指标，尤其是在低码率下。

As illustrated in Figure 6, under 0.01 bpp, SRD is crucial for maintaining the fundamental structure and color information.

如图 6 所示，当码率低于 0.01 bpp 时，SRD 对保留基本结构与颜色至关重要；

At higher bitrates, SRD can still help to preserve fine-grained details, such as the patterns on the roof.

在更高码率下，它仍有助于保留屋顶图案等精细细节。

W/o GM-BMSRQ. To prove the group mask used for BMSRQ can improve the compression ratio at ultra-low bitrates, we train the BMSRQ with the channel dimension of 16 without using group mask.

不使用 GM-BMSRQ。为验证用于 BMSRQ 的分组掩码能提高超低码率下的压缩比，我们在不使用分组掩码的情况下训练通道维度为 16 的 BMSRQ。

As shown in Figure 7, removing the group mask leads to a noticeable rise in bitrates, demonstrating that group mask effectively improves the compression ratio, especially at ultra-low bitrates.

如图 7 所示，移除分组掩码后码率明显上升，说明分组掩码能有效提高压缩比，尤其是在超低码率下。

5 CONCLUSION

5 结论

We introduce a novel progressive neural compression framework, ARPC, which intuitively utilizes the coarse-to-fine generation paradigm of VAR based on next-scale prediction to achieve progressive coding,

我们提出渐进神经压缩框架 ARPC，利用基于下一尺度预测的 VAR 由粗到细的生成范式实现渐进编码，

and leverages the priors of the pre-trained VAR to reconstruct images with high realism and visual quality at ultra-low bitrates.

并借助预训练 VAR 的先验，在超低码率下重建逼真且视觉质量较高的图像。

Extensive results indicate that ARPC can not only achieve SOTA progressive compression performance but also improve the decompression efficiency.

大量实验表明，ARPC 能达到先进的渐进压缩性能，并提高解压效率。

We discussion the LLMs usage in Appendix A.9.

有关 LLM 的使用见附录 A.9。

伦理声明

All the researches in this paper conform the ICLR Code of Ethics1.

本文所有研究均遵守 ICLR 伦理准则¹。

Our efforts include, but are not limited to: 1) The method we propose can be used for progressive image compression systems, which meets social needs, and can be broadly accessible, without threats to health, safety, personal security, and privacy.

我们的努力包括但不限于以下方面：1）所提方法可用于渐进图像压缩系统，符合社会需求，能够广泛使用，不对健康、安全、人身安全与隐私构成威胁。

A.3 ARITHMETIC CODING

A.3 算术编码

Arithmetic coding is a form of lossless entropy coding.

算术编码是一种无损熵编码。

The core idea of arithmetic coding is to map an entire message to a single floating-point number within the interval [0, 1).

其核心思想是将整条消息映射到区间 [0,1) 内的一个浮点数。

Based on the probabilities of each symbol, the current interval is partitioned into multiple sub-intervals.

根据各符号的概率，将当前区间划分为多个子区间。

Through an iterative process, a very small interval is obtained, and its lower bound is used as the encoded result.

通过迭代得到一个很小的区间，并将其下界作为编码结果。

The pseudocode of arithmetic coding is shown in algorithm 3 and algorithm 4.

算法 3 和算法 4 给出了算术编码的伪代码。

A.4 FURTHER EXPERIMENT RESULTS

A.4 补充实验结果

We further consider the distortion metrics, PSNR and MS-SSIM, for comparison. The results are shown in Figure 8 and Figure 9.

我们进一步比较失真指标 PSNR 和 MS-SSIM，结果见图 8 和图 9。

The last point on the rate-distortion curve represents the case where all K scales of tokens are transmitted from the sender to the receiver.

率失真曲线的最后一点对应将所有 K 个尺度的词元传至接收端。

In this scenario, the receiver only takes the VAR as a probability estimator for lossless decompression, not for generation.

此时，接收端仅将 VAR 用作无损解压的概率估计器，不用于生成。

Therefore, the compression performance at this bitrate is equivalent to the VAE’s reconstruction performance.

因此，这一码率下的压缩性能等同于 VAE 的重建性能。

Since the reconstruction performance of a discrete VAE is worse than that of a continuous VAE, ARPC’s compression performance shows a slight drop compared to DiffPC at higher bitrates.

由于离散 VAE 的重建性能低于连续 VAE，在较高码率下，ARPC 的压缩表现相比 DiffPC 略有下降。

However, it still achieves SOTA results on FID and KID, demonstrating ARPC’s superior statistical fidelity.

不过，ARPC 的 FID 和 KID 仍达到先进水平，说明其统计保真度较好。

Furthermore, we present the comparison results on Kodak dataset, as shown in Figure 10.

此外，我们在图 10 中展示 Kodak 数据集上的比较结果。

We don’t report the FID and KID score due to the limited size of Kodak dataset.

由于 Kodak 规模较小，不报告 FID 与 KID。

The results show that ARPC maintains outstanding performance on the Kodak dataset as well.

结果表明，ARPC 在 Kodak 上也保持了良好表现。

We provide the qualitative comparisons in Figure 11. The results demonstrate that ARPC can reconstruct images with complex and correct textures, such as the color around the eye.

图 11 给出定性对比，表明 ARPC 能重建复杂且正确的纹理，例如眼周的颜色。

Figure 8: Quantitative comparisons across both perception and distortion metrics on DIV2K.

图 8：DIV2K 上感知与失真指标的定量比较。

图 9：CLIC2020 上感知与失真指标的定量比较。

Figure 10: Quantitative comparisons with SOTA methods on Kodak dataset.

图 10：Kodak 数据集上与先进方法的定量比较。

A.5 FURTHER ABLATION EXPERIMENT

A.5 补充消融实验

A.5.1 VOCABULARY SIZE OF BITWISE MULTI-SCALE RESIDUAL QUANTIZER

A.5.1 逐比特多尺度残差量化器的词表大小

Improving the vocabulary size of the bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer can improve the reconstruction capability of the VAE, but increase the bitrates at the same time.

增大逐比特多尺度残差量化器的词表可以增强 VAE 的重建能力，但也会提高码率。

We further explore the effect of increasing the vocabulary size on compression performance.

我们进一步考察增大词表对压缩性能的影响，

We increase the channel dimension of the bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer to c = 32, and configure the channels for the three groups to be 16, 24, and 32, respectively.

将量化器的通道维度增至 c=32，三组通道数分别设为 16、24、32。

As shown in Figure 13, at low bitrates, the decompressed image quality is similar for both models.

如图 13 所示，在低码率下，两种模型的解压图像质量相近；

However, the model with a channel dimension of 32 can achieve higher bitrates and exhibits better performance at higher bitrates.

通道维度为 32 的模型可达到更高码率，并在高码率下表现更好，

This is mainly due to the bitwise VAE has a better reconstruction performance with a larger vocabulary size.

主要因为词表较大的逐比特 VAE 具有更强的重建能力。

Figure 13: Quantitative ablation study of vocabulary size for group-masked bitwise multi-scale residual quantizer. Tested on DIV2K validation set.

图 13：分组掩码逐比特多尺度残差量化器词表大小的定量消融，在 DIV2K 验证集上测试。

A.5.2 ABLATION RESULTS OF BITWISE VISUAL TOKENIZER

A.5.2 逐比特视觉词元器的消融结果

We divide K scales into three groups based on the observation of each scale and apply different group mask for each group, retaining the bitwise visual tokenizer to adaptively allocate bits for different scales.

根据对各尺度的观察，我们把 K 个尺度分为三组，并为各组应用不同掩码，保留逐比特视觉词元器，使比特可按尺度自适应分配。

What’s more, we apply scale random dropout strategy to enhance the semantic information preservation in the earlier scales.

我们还采用尺度随机丢弃策略，增强早期尺度对语义信息的保留。

We show the effect of the above two strategies on reconstruction quality of bitwise visual tokenizer in Table 2.

表 2 展示这两种策略对逐比特视觉词元器重建质量的影响。

We use the validation set of ImageNet for evaluation with the input resolution of 512×512.

评估使用 ImageNet 验证集，输入分辨率为 512×512。

Since these strategies are all designed to improve the compression performance at ultra-low bitrates, either by reducing the vocabulary size of earlier scales or by focusing on earlier scales to retain more semantic information,

两种策略均面向超低码率压缩，通过缩小早期尺度的词表或让早期尺度保留更多语义信息来提高性能，

they inevitably have a slight impact on the overall reconstruction capability of the VAE.

因此不可避免地对 VAE 的整体重建能力产生轻微影响。

Table 2: The effect of GM-BMSRQ and SRD on visual tokenizer.

表 2：GM-BMSRQ 与 SRD 对视觉词元器的影响。

A.5.3 ABLATION STUDY OF IMAGE CAPTION LENGTH

A.5.3 图像描述长度消融

We use the BLIP2 model to generate the image caption in this paper. And we further evaluate if a more detailed image caption can bring better compression performance, as illustrated in Figure 14.

本文用 BLIP2 生成图像描述，并进一步评估更详细的描述能否改善压缩性能，结果见图 14。

We use DIV2K validation set as our testset and use the advanced InternVL 2.0 model to provide more detailed captions.

我们在 DIV2K 验证集上测试，用 InternVL 2.0 生成更详细的描述。

The results show that captions generated by BLIP2 and InterVL 2.0 yield similar compression performance.

BLIP2 与 InternVL 2.0 的描述带来的压缩性能相近。

For CLIP Score, using the caption from InternVL 2.0 model can achieve higher score at ultra-low bitrates.

在超低码率下，使用 InternVL 2.0 描述可获得更高的 CLIP Score。

This is mainly because the CLIP Score measures semantic similarity, and more detailed captions can provide more detailed semantics for the generation process.

主要原因是 CLIP Score 衡量语义相似度，而更详细的描述能为生成过程提供更丰富的语义。

What’s more, we evaluate the compression performance without image caption.

我们也评估不传输描述时的压缩性能。

As shown in Figure 14, at ultra-low bitrates, the absence of an image caption has a severe impact on the quality of the decompressed image.

如图 14 所示，在超低码率下缺少描述会严重影响解压图像质量。

The tokens of earlier scales primarily encode structural layout, lacking finer semantic details of the original images, making the decompression heavily dependent on the guidance of a caption.

早期尺度词元主要编码结构布局，缺少原图更细致的语义，因而解压高度依赖描述的引导。

As the number of transmitted scales increases, at higher bitrates, comparable compression performance is achievable even without a caption.

随着传输尺度增多、码率升高，即使没有描述，也能达到相近的压缩性能。

Figure 14: Quantitative ablation study of image captions with different length.

图 14：不同长度图像描述的定量消融。

A.5.4 ABLATION STUDY OF DIFFERENT MASK CONFIGURATION

A.5.4 不同掩码配置的消融

Based on our observation, we divide 13 scales into three groups of sizes 4, 5, and 4, respectively.

根据观察，我们将 13 个尺度分成大小分别为 4、5、4 的三组。

We further give two different choices for masking, dividing 13 scales into (5,6,2) and (2,2,9).

我们还给出两种掩码方案，即（5,6,2）和（2,2,9）。

Table 3 shows the BD-rates on DIV2K dataset with the default configuration (i.e., 4,5,4) as the baseline.

表 3 展示了 DIV2K 上相对于默认配置（4,5,4）的 BD-rate。

The results show that configuration 1, (5,6,2), compresses more information into a low-dimensional feature space, which can achieve lower bitrates.

方案一（5,6,2）把更多信息压缩至低维特征空间，可以达到更低码率，

However, it severely compromises the representation capability of GM-BMSRQ, resulting in a degradation in the reconstructed image.

却明显削弱 GM-BMSRQ 的表示能力，使重建图像质量下降。

While configuration 2, (2,2,9), effectively preserves the representation capability, it leads to a significant reduction in the compression ratio, especially at ultra-low bitrates.

方案二（2,2,9）能有效保留表示能力，却显著降低压缩比，尤其是在超低码率下。

Table 3: BD-rate of different mask configuration for GM-BMSRQ.

表 3：GM-BMSRQ 不同掩码配置的 BD-rate。

A.5.5 COMPARISON WITH VANILLA VAR

A.5.5 与原始 VAR 的比较

To demonstrate the superiority of ARPC over the vanilla VAR, we report the compression performance of directly using VAR for encoding and decoding, and compared with the SOTA compression method, StableCodec, as shown in Table 4.

为验证 ARPC 相较原始 VAR 的优势，我们报告直接用 VAR 编解码的性能，并与先进压缩方法 StableCodec 对比，如表 4 所示。

The BDrate is calculated on DIV2K dataset with ARPC as the baseline.

BD-rate 在 DIV2K 上以 ARPC 为基线计算。

In vanilla VAR, the image semantics are concentrated in the final few scale tokens, which is suboptimal for progressive compression.

原始 VAR 的图像语义集中于最后几个尺度，不利于渐进压缩。

Moreover, the earlier scales represent coarse, low-frequency information with low information density, but they share the same high-dimensional feature space and codebook as later scales with high information density.

此外，早期尺度表示信息密度较低的粗粒度低频信息，却与高信息密度的后期尺度共享相同的高维特征空间和码本。

This results in representation redundancy, leading to inefficient information transmission, particularly at ultra-low bitrates.

这使表示产生冗余，降低了传输效率，尤其是在超低码率下。

Table 4: BD-rate comparison with vanilla VAR.

表 4：与原始 VAR 的 BD-rate 比较。

A.6 VISUAL RESULTS FOR SPECIAL SCENARIOS

A.6 特殊场景的视觉结果

We further present visual results for some challenging scenarios, such as the images containing face and text.

我们进一步展示包含人脸和文字等有挑战场景的视觉结果。

We categorized text and faces into three classes following DiffPC based on their proportions within the entire frame - large, medium and small, as shown in Figure 12 and Figure 15.

参照 DiffPC，按文字或人脸在整幅图像中的占比将其分为大、中、小三类，见图 12 和图 15。

For images containing face, ARPC can reconstruct high realism images even at low bitrates. While other diffusion-based methods exhibit significant artifacts or texture loss.

对含人脸的图像，ARPC 即使在低码率下也能重建逼真的图像，其他扩散方法则出现明显伪影或纹理损失。

PerCo shows noticeable color incorrect.

PerCo 存在显著的色彩偏差，

DiffEIC and DiffPC present oversmoothing of the skin for large and medium faces.

DiffEIC 和 DiffPC 对中、大人脸的皮肤过度平滑。

For images containing text, ARPC can also achieve good image reconstruction quality, even for the small text, such as “TESLA.COM” under the license plate.

对于包含文字的图像，ARPC 也能取得较好的重建质量，即使是车牌下方的“TESLA.COM”等小字。

Figure 15: The image containing text.

图 15：包含文字的图像。

A.7 SELECTION OF k

A.7 k 的选择

A.7.1 COMPRESSION EFFICIENCY

A.7.1 压缩效率

As we illustrated in section 4.2, ARPC utilized the probability predicted by VAR to losslessly re-encode the token indices.

如第 4.2 节所述，ARPC 利用 VAR 预测概率，无损重编码词元索引。

As a result, the encoding time increases with higher bitrates, a large value of k.

因此，编码耗时随着码率和 k 的增大而增加。

However, unlike the diffc, which has consistent computational cost per iteration, the encoding complexity is low at low bitrates as fewer token counts at early scales.

DiffC 每次迭代的计算成本较稳定，而 ARPC 在低码率下的编码复杂度较低，因为早期尺度的词元较少。

We further provide the specific encoding times and bitrates for different numbers of transmitted scales k.

表 5 给出不同传输尺度数 k 的具体编码时间和码率。

As shown in Table 5, when transmitting tokens from fewer than 10 scales, the encoding time is under 3 seconds and the bitrate is below 0.025 bpp.

传输少于 10 个尺度的词元时，编码时间低于 3 秒，码率低于 0.025 bpp。

As the number of tokens in the last 3 scales increases, it leads to a significant increase in compression time.

最后三个尺度的词元数增多，使压缩耗时显著上升。

Furthermore, we provide the encoding and decoding times for different input image sizes, as shown in Table 6, demonstrating the low decoding complexity of ARPC.

表 6 还给出不同输入图像尺寸的编解码时间，表明 ARPC 的解码复杂度较低。

Table 5: The encoding time and bitrate when selecting different k.

表 5：选择不同 k 值时的编码时间与码率。

Table 6: Inference efficiency with different input image size.

表 6：不同输入图像尺寸下的推理效率。

A.7.2 VISUAL RESULTS OF THE PROGRESSIVE DECOMPRESSION.

A.7.2 渐进解压的视觉结果

We further present the visual results of transmitting different scales from k = 5 to k = 13 (all discrete tokens are transmitted), as shown in Figure 16.

图 16 展示传输尺度数由 k=5 增至 k=13（传输全部离散词元）的视觉结果。

For a smaller k (low bitrates), the decompressed image is similar to the original image only in terms of semantics and image layout.

k 较小时（低码率），解压图像仅在语义和布局上与原图相似，

Therefore ARPC relies more on the VAR’s generative capacity to reconstruct a high-realism image.

ARPC 更依赖 VAR 的生成能力重建逼真的图像。

As the value of k increases, more tokens are transmitted, and the details of the image are gradually completed.

随着 k 增大，传输词元增多，图像细节逐步得到补全。

Figure 16: Visual comparison for different value of k.

A.8 LIGHTWEIGHT DEPLOYMENT FOR COMPUTATIONAL RESOURCES-CONSTRAINED SCENARIOS

A.8 算力受限场景的轻量部署

To demonstrate the potential for practical applications, we conduct further experiments using BLIP (a lightweight caption model) and consider a lightweight deployment strategy.

为说明实际应用潜力，我们采用轻量级图像描述模型 BLIP 进一步实验，并考察轻量部署策略。

We give the parameter counts and BD-rate comparison in Table 7 and Table 8.

参数量与 BD-rate 对比分别见表 7 和表 8。

  • Replacing BLIP-2 with BLIP: We replaced the large BLIP-2 model with the more lightweight BLIP model.

  • 用 BLIP 替换 BLIP-2。我们以更轻量的 BLIP 替换较大的 BLIP-2。

As shown in the BD-rate table below, utilizing BLIP (w/ LRE) yields compression performance very similar to the baseline BLIP-2.

如下方 BD-rate 表所示，使用 BLIP 并保留 LRE 时，压缩性能与 BLIP-2 基线非常接近。

  • Lightweight deployment w/o LRE: For scenarios strictly constrained by computational resources at the sender’s end (e.g., mobile devices), we can directly transmit token indices without lossless re-encoding (LRE).

  • 不使用 LRE 的轻量部署。发送端算力受到严格限制时（如移动设备），可直接传输词元索引，省去无损重编码（LRE）。

This eliminates the need to deploy the VAR model at the sender, requiring only the VAE encoder and the lightweight caption model.

发送端无需部署 VAR，只需要 VAE 编码器和轻量描述模型。

Such strategy reduces the parameters at the sender’s end from 2.2B to 268.8M.

该策略将发送端参数量由 2.2B 降至 268.8M。

Although removing LRE results in a BD-rate increase (∼25%) due to the lack of probability estimation, it offers a viable solution for edge devices.

虽然因缺少概率估计，移除 LRE 会使 BD-rate 上升约 25%，但可为边缘设备提供可行方案。

Table 7: Model parameters for lightweight deployment using BLIP and w/o LRE.

表 7：使用 BLIP 并移除 LRE 的轻量部署所需模型参数。

Table 8: BD-rate comparison for lightweight deployment using BLIP and w/o LRE.

表 8：使用 BLIP 并移除 LRE 的轻量部署的 BD-rate 比较。

The BD-rate is calculated on DIV2K dataset with using BLIP-2 caption model and LRE as the baseline.

在 DIV2K 上，以使用 BLIP-2 描述模型和 LRE 的方案为基线计算 BD-rate。

A.9 THE USE OF LARGE LANGUAGE MODELS

A.9 大语言模型的使用

In this paper, we only use the LLMs for grammar checking and writing refinement as a generalpurpose assist tool.

本文仅将大语言模型作为通用辅助工具，用于语法检查和行文润色。

All scientific content, including methodologies, data, and conclusions, is proposed by the authors and not influenced by the use of LLMs.

包括方法、数据和结论在内的所有科学内容均由作者提出，不受大语言模型影响。

All usage of LLMs is conducted with careful oversight by the authors to ensure accuracy.

作者对大语言模型的使用进行了仔细监督，以确保准确性。
